observations: SceneCodec.encode validates before JSON encoding; decode enforces the 1,048,576-byte bound, fully decodes, and validates before returning. There is no partial scene return path.

LightingScene.validated rejects schema versions outside 1...5 before count or content checks, preserves the 12-light ceiling, and rejects optics in v1, cameraLens before v3, previewSettings before v4, and placementRoom or rollDegrees before v5.

Validation checks finite/range validity of positions, lights, lens, preview settings and room, plus duplicate light identities. Migration copies the value and changes only schemaVersion to 5, preserving IDs and settings.

Related test source covers literal v1 identity/settings migration, v2 optics/default lens, v3 lens/default preview, v4 legacy room/roll defaults, v5 room/roll round-trip, light-count boundary across all versions, future-version precedence, malformed/oversized bytes and invalid nested settings.
